title: ‘Can’t live here anymore’: Collapse sends Satya Niketan students packing
content: In light of a nearby building collapse, students from Satya Niketan are vacating their rooms, prompted by urgent safety concerns regarding nearby structures. While some are heading back to their hometowns, others are securing temporary housing within colleges. Property owners are taking down PG signboards to avoid scrutiny, and volunteers are stepping in to help with rescue operations and to provide essential supplies to those affected.

title: ‘Delhi mein sab chalta hai’: 2 tragedies in 3 months add to city's civic failures

Officials previously involved in a similar incident faced suspension after the second disaster.  Authorities have initiated inspections and demolition drives across the city.  The city faces persistent questions about its ability to prevent future fatal incidents.

Devdutt Padikkal will take the reins of the multi-day team, while Ruturaj Gaikwad steps up as captain of the one-day lineup. Set to unfold in Puducherry, the series comprises two multi-day matches and three one-day games.

title: He lost his Rs 2 lakh MacBook on Bengaluru road; what happened next restored his faith

title: Nepal’s flood bill could hit $5 billion. Where will the money come from?

To restore infrastructure and homes effectively, both local resources and international assistance will play pivotal roles. The nation is actively pursuing funding opportunities with development banks and climate finance, emphasizing the importance of resilient rebuilding strategies for securing its long-term future.

title: 'No one even told us': Noskova questions roof closure delay after loss to Sabalenka
content: Sabalenka was leading 5-4 in the third set when Noskova stepped up to serve. At that point, most of the court was still in sunlight. By the time Noskova played her first point, the shadow had moved close to the middle of the court. After she won that point, almost the entire court was in shade when the next point started.

title: 1980s AI photo trend: 11 ChatGPT prompts to turn photos into retro Bollywood looks

title: 'Poster-boy actions': Vijay Mallya's message to those calling him 'bhagoda'

title: Nearly 30,000 ship arrivals increased Alaska’s invasive species risk by 50%
content: Researchers found that nearly 30,000 commercial vessel arrivals brought 430 sq km of submerged surface area to Alaska between 2012 and 2022. The study says this surface can carry marine organisms through biofouling. Passenger vessels accounted for more than half of the total area, while warming waters and increased Arctic shipping could raise the risk of non-indigenous species reaching Alaska.

title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Ultra launch on Sep 9: Likely specifications and price

The standard iPhone 18 models are delayed until spring 2027, impacting the autumn pricing strategy. New Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 are also expected at the event.

title: He scored 99th percentile in CAT but chose Army; meet Col Anurag Upadhyay
content: Colonel Anurag Upadhyay, a former Indian Army Special Forces officer, is seeking expert medical and technological support after suffering a severe stroke in August 2025 that resulted in locked-in syndrome and bilateral below-knee amputations. Despite remaining conscious and communicating through eye movements, his family is exploring advanced rehabilitation, neurological research and assistive technologies such as brain-computer interfaces and eye-tracking systems. A public appeal seeks credible specialists, institutions and organisations that could help identify further possibilities for recovery and independence.

title: Sugar refiners plan to sell 2.5 lakh tonnes domestically as govt moves to boost supplies
content: Indian sugar refiners are set to release 2.5 lakh tonnes of white sugar into the domestic market, aiming to meet rising demand and reduce costs before the upcoming festive season. Government initiatives have helped lower sugar prices at mills, and a new policy allows duty-free import of 10 lakh tonnes of raw sugar, prompting mills to start crushing early for better production outcomes.

title: Cheaper homes, faster clearances: Real estate experts lay out reforms for growth
content: In the face of surging land prices, real estate professionals are urging the implementation of quicker project approvals and the digitization of land records to streamline business operations. They also highlight the need for a robust affordable housing policy to assist everyday buyers. Industry figures stress the importance of embracing technology to bolster accountability and efficiency in the sector, paving the way for smarter, sustainable construction practices.

title: India-US trade deal soon? Commerce secy gives update on long-awaited pact
content: India and the United States are nearing a trade deal, focusing on preferential market access.  Other trade agreements with Chile and New Zealand are also progressing well.  India aims to diversify its services exports beyond IT and professional sectors.  The nation sees significant growth potential in its fintech and e-commerce sectors.  Reducing remittance costs offers substantial benefits for migrant workers globally.

title: ‘Civilisational twins’: Rajnath meets Sri Lankan prez, steps up India’s defence ties

Sri Lanka reiterated its commitment to India's security interests and acknowledged India's assistance. Both leaders virtually inaugurated three Bailey Bridges constructed by Indian defence forces. Memorandums of understanding were exchanged to boost defence cooperation between the two nations.

title: Brent crude hits $100 after fresh wave of Middle East attacks

The U.S. military responded by targeting five Iranian tankers, which were involved in missile strikes, while Houthi rebels ignited oil facilities in Saudi Arabia. These escalating conflicts have driven prices higher.

title: Human rights organisations condemn 'racist murder' of Manipuri singer in Delhi

Advocates pointed out the government’s failure to implement previous recommendations aimed at combating racial biases against Northeast residents.

title: Orangutans in Odisha: How did apes not native to India end up in Balasore forest

Authorities suspect international trafficking after the animals appeared far from their native habitat.  The critically endangered apes may have been abandoned by traffickers fearing imminent arrest.  A special task force and the Wildlife Crime Control Bureau are investigating the incident.  Officials believe the orangutans reached Odisha through an international trans-oceanic trafficking network.

title: Why should BCCI, State bodies be not governed by National Sports Governance Act, asks Supreme Court
content: The Supreme Court’s inquiry follows years of legal scrutiny and reform initiatives aimed at enhancing transparency and accountability within Indian cricket governance

title: No complaints received on damage from ethanol-blended petrol: Telangana Transport Minister
content: Use of petrol blended with 20% ethanol (E20) could result in a 3 to 5% reduction in vehicle pickup and mileage, says Ponnam Prabhakar

title: We built 50,000 rail coaches, Congress regime could not build 50,000 toilets: Modi
content: PM Modi addressed a large gathering after inaugurating and laying the foundation stone of ₹35,000 crore projects at a programme in Vadodara in Gujarat

title: ‘Reservation Hatao Andolan’ solidifies into quota reforms/general category interest platform
content: The movement has now prepared a charter of demands that calls for a National Commission for the General Category, the complete rollback of the UGC’s 2026 caste-equity rules, and a review of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities Act)

title: Decision on ED request for FIR against Pinarayi, daughter in CMRL case after legal scrutiny: Keralam CM
content: V.D. Satheesan says ‘major’ allegations have been raised in ED’s letter seeking registration of case against Pinarayi Vijayan, T. Veena and Mohamed Riyas under Prevention of Corruption Act

title: Lynching of Manipur musician Chongtham Vikram Singh sparks outcry over northeast discrimination in Delhi
content: Soon after the killing of the musician from Imphal, several civil society organisations representing communities from northeast India called for introspection on how they are treated in certain parts of India

title: Chongtham Vikram Singh was a peace-loving musician who lived a peaceful life, says wife
content: Activist Binalakshmi Nepram seeks life imprisonment for accused, says government’s responsibility to educate people so they "love and respect us, not kill us"

title: 177 Velampeta families to get flats where their huts stand; ₹40 crore slum redevelopment begins in Visakhapatnam
content: Minister P. Narayana lays the foundation stone for the State’s first in-situ slum redevelopment, to be built in nine months with shear-wall technology; each family gets ₹3,000 a month in rent meanwhile, and residents who have waited decades say it feels like a dream

title: Delhi High Court notice on plea for DU hostels, safety audits of PGs
content: The plea has been filed in the wake of the September 6 collapse of multi-storey buildings being used as student PG accommodation at Satya Niketan

title: ED raids premises linked to Karnataka PWD Minister Satish Jarkiholi, his daughter
content: No clarity on whether the Minister is at any of the locations being raided; the ED clarified that the latest raids against the Jarkiholis are not related to the excise case and is an independent new case

title: FCNR(B) deposits: Who bears the currency risk? | Explained
content: The RBI swap shields banks from currency risk on the principal, while banks have to manage dollar interest payments themselves, leaving some exposed if the rupee weakens

title: MP medical interns’ protest enters Day 3 as they demand stipend hike, slam police ‘action’
content: Doctors at the government-run Gandhi Medical College (GMC) in Bhopal have announced a boycott of the OPD

title: If casteism ends, we are ready to give up reservation: Athawale
content: The Union Minister said those opposing reservation should engage in dialogue and put forward their demands

title: Keralam CM accepts apology of expelled Congress leader Chenthi Anil who waylaid him, says no grudge
content: Satheesan says he feels that the expelled leader has become ‘the bigger person’ by apologising after coming out of jail

title: Satya Niketan building collapse: PG operator arrested by police
content: According to officials, the police are examining the role of leaseholders of the building and the construction and repair work being carried out in the basement and on the ground floor

title: Seems PM Modi wants entire caste census process to fail: Congress
content: Congress general secretary in-charge communications Jairam Ramesh said his party has held 17 press conferences across the country in the last four days and reiterated the demand for conducting the caste census in the right manner

title: Andhra Pradesh unveils roadmap to ensure 24X7 quality power supply amid El Niño challenges
content: State to procure 1,600 MW of thermal power through tariff-based competitive bidding; developers to maintain a mandatory 15-day coal stock; DISCOMs told to prepare a 12-month supply plan

title: Newborn girl found abandoned on district hospital compound; police check CCTV
content: Attendants of patients hear the infant’s cries in the early hours and alert the authorities; the child protection wing moves her to a care centre and the police examine footage to trace who left her

title: Justice Pushpendra Bhati sworn in as Chief Justice of J&K, Ladakh High Court
content: Chief Minister Omar Abdullah, judges of the High Court and subordinate courts were present at the oath-taking ceremony

title: AAP legislator Mehraj Malik approaches J&K High Court to restore ‘withdrawn security cover’, escort
content: In the petition, Mr. Malik placed before the Court the security concerns surrounding him as a Legislator

title: Farmer electrocuted by snapped live wire in his field in Anantapur district
content: Adinarayana, 60, comes in contact with the wire lying in his groundnut field at Turakapalle in Peddapappuru mandal while watering the crop; a case is registered

title: 'Attack on one is attack on all': Pakistan warns Houthis, invokes Mecca defence pact
content: Prisha Patnaik is a journalist with The Times of India, writing across geopolitics, international affairs, culture, history and internet culture. With over two years of experience in social media and digital content, she is interested in how news, politics and culture are shaped for digital audiences. She holds a master’s degree in Media and Communications from Goldsmiths, University of London.

title: 'Make ground in Gaza tremble': Egypt warned Netanyahu of Hamas plans before October 7
content: details emerge on Egypt’s warning to Netanyahu Fresh details have emerged about warnings issued to Israel ahead of the October 7, 2023, attack . the latest information sheds further light on previously reported warnings from Egyptian intelligence officials during the same period . an Egyptian intelligence official said Jerusalem ignored repeated warnings that the terror group was planning “something big”
